reasons.tested: An option in the rotation. The simulator compares it with the alternatives and it is not chosen.
reasons.starved: In the rotation, but the character has no mana left when it becomes usable, so it is never cast.
reasons.multi: Built for several targets or close range. The fight has one target.
reasons.reactive: Needs the target to attack, cast or be attacked. The training target does nothing.
reasons.kill: Needs a killing blow. The target does not die.
reasons.type: Works on some creature types only. The training target has none.
reasons.utility: Control, threat or movement tool with little damage. Not tested as a damage option.
reasons.talent: Needs a talent that no simulated build takes.
reasons.form: Needs a form, stance or weapon the simulated build does not use.
reasons.untested: Could add single-target damage. It is not in the rotation and has not been tested.

dwarf.name: Big Game Hunter
dwarf.note: +5% damage against Beasts only. The training target has no creature type.

gnome.name: Eureka!
gnome.note: +10% non-periodic damage for 8 s every 2 min in every class. The 10% lower cost is applied to Mage and Priest mana only, not to rage, energy or other casters.

orc.name: Blood Fury
orc.note: +10% attack power and spell power for 15 s every 2 min.

troll.name: Berserking
troll.note: +10% attack and cast speed for 15 s every 3 min.

troll.name: Beast Slaying
troll.note: Damage against Beasts only. The training target has no creature type.

undead.name: Touch of the Grave
undead.note: 20% chance on the character's own damage (assumed), 15 s internal cooldown, 5% of maximum health as Shadow damage. Health counts Stamina only (assumed).

sho.name: Read Ley Line
sho.note: +50% regeneration for 15 s. Its cooldown and what it regenerates are not published, so it is left out.
